text:
sarah_recruiter: Hi team — Olivia (new hire, Sales Engineer) is starting Mon 9am at SF office. Two issues: 1) Checkr flagged an "ID mismatch" on the background check (case 98-3142). Candidate sent passport yesterday but it may not have matched. 2) Laptop + badge need provisioning and desk access by 8:45am. Can we triage? :wave:

elaine_peopleops: @sarah_recruiter thanks for the heads up. For the ID mismatch we usually ask candidate to bring original passport + secondary ID on day 1 and complete an in-person I-9 if remote docs are inconsistent. Do we want to mark this as an "exception review" so security is looped in?

jamal_hrops: tagging @security_team — please advise if in-person I-9 is ok here or we need a remedial background check step. Also can Checkr be re-opened by us or does candidate need to re-submit?

security_team: @jamal_hrops generally in-person verification with originals is fine if the office can validate. If there was potential fraud (low confidence score) we'll ask Checkr to do an identity supplement. Share the candidate DOB and the Checkr case link in DM.

matt_it: For hardware — I reserved a spare 13" M1 for Olivia on campus-hotspares. Need exact shipping/delivery or pickup? If she's onsite Mon we can have the laptop imaged and on the desk by 8:30, just need asset tag printed and badge activated.

sarah_recruiter: She's flying in and will be onsite. I'll confirm arrival time (likely 8:20). Also she asked about VPN/KMS access for first day — is there a fast path? :thinking_face:

matt_it: We can do expedited onboarding if we get an access ticket by EOD Fri. Please fill the quick provisioning form: https://internal.redwood/onboard/fast-path (link internal). Paste this payload in case system needs it:
```
name: Olivia Chen
role: Sales Engineer
start_date: 2026-04-06
workplace: SF-office
needs_vpn: yes
manager: sarah_recruiter
```
I'll create the ticket once you post the form.

elaine_peopleops: For day-1 orientation schedule, planning to run 9:00–11:30 main session (benefits + policies + paperwork) then team lunch. Can you confirm HR table space and A/V? Also we need signed I-9 and direct-deposit form. If candidate brings original passport we can complete Section 2 of the I-9 in person.

onboarding-bot: Reminder — new-hire packet for Olivia Chen has been created: https://redwood.hr/onboarding/olivia_chen. Includes: W-4, I-9 editable PDF, direct deposit form, code of conduct ack. Please ensure forms completed by EOD Mon.

jamal_hrops: Sarah, can you ask Olivia to bring originals for I-9: passport OR passport + driver's license. If passport presented, that's sufficient. If she can't, we'll schedule a secure video verification (per policy) but that may delay final clearance.

sarah_recruiter: Will do. I'll DM Olivia with instructions and ask her to upload the passport image to Checkr and also bring originals. I'll also submit the provisioning payload and cc @matt_it. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

matt_it: One more thing — badge activation needs the office desk number. @sarah_recruiter can you confirm desk? If unknown we can assign temporary access (lobby + 7th floor) and escalate to permanent after badge photo.

elaine_peopleops: Quick checklist for the thread: 
- Confirm passport originals on arrival (if not, schedule video exception)
- JAMAL/Security review Checkr case if any fraud indicators
- MAT T: image laptop + activate VPN ticket by EOD Fri
- Onboarding-bot: send calendar invites + orientation materials
- Sarah: confirm desk and candidate arrival ETA

sarah_recruiter: checklist noted — ETA 8:20 (will update if changes). I'll upload passport image to Checkr and DM @jamal_hrops. Thanks everyone!
